text:
If you’re heading out for sunset, you’ve got a clear, comfortable evening ahead, with the sun slipping away at 7:10. Temperatures are in the mid 60s now, skies stay clear, and a light breeze settles as the night turns noticeably cooler. We’re headed for a low near 49, likely the coolest morning of the season so far, so you’ll want a layer for an early start.

Saturday looks like the pick of the weekend for sunshine, warming from that chilly start to a high around 77. The forecast spread is a little wider than usual, from the low to upper 70s, but I’d bet on a pleasant afternoon. South winds build on the lake, with waves reaching 2 to 4 feet, so keep an eye on conditions if you’re boating. Most of Saturday night stays dry, though a shower could arrive after midnight.
